title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Pond
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：duck　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 duck 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my grandmother ① kept a duck that no child in the yard would have fed, and she said the keeping was the whole of the winter. The ② duck, meaning the bird and not the dodge, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a duck, she said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left unfed.

Every ③ duck in that yard had the same short pond at the end of it, and the ④ duck at the end, meaning the one they kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A duck, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to feed; my grandmother said the feeding is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the duck was the whole of the story, meaning the dodge and not the bird. The ⑥ duck, meaning the dodge and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody practises and nobody praises; duck, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a bird and a dodge. He said the dodge is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ duck had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short pond. The ⑧ duck of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one yard and fourteen winters of feeding; duck, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to feed. She said the feeding was never mentioned.

The ⑨ duck I remember is the one named in the ledger, which died in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ duck, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being fed; every duck, she said, is a dodge that has agreed to look like a bird. She said the dodge was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。

B. n. 鸭子（指那只鸭子本身，与闪避动作相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a duck 养一只鸭子
D. n. 鸭子（指留给过冬的那一只）

F. n. 鸭子（指账本上写到、被列名的那一只）
G. n. 闪避；低头躲闪（指故事里人人都练却无人叫好的那样动作）

answers.why: keep a duck 意为“养一只鸭子”，1952 年祖母养了一只院子里没有一个孩子肯去喂的鸭子。
duck 意为“鸭子”，指那只鸭子本身而不是闪避动作，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
duck 意为“鸭子”，指那个院子里的每一只鸭子，每一只到头都有同一个小小的水塘。
duck 意为“鸭子”，指留给过冬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
duck 意为“闪避、低头躲闪”，指故事里人人都练却无人叫好的那样动作，叔叔说这个闪避就是那个故事的全部。
duck 意为“闪避”，指人人都练却无人叫好的那种动作而不是那只鸭子，是故事里人人都练、却无人叫好的东西。
duck 意为“鸭子”，指账本上写到、被列名的那一只，到 1961 年这只鸭子成了账本里的一行。
duck 意为“鸭子”，祖母一月写道，整件事的养鸭之事是一个院子和十四个冬天的喂食。
duck 意为“鸭子”，我记得的是账本上列名的那一只，1973 年死了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一只。
duck 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一只鸭子是唯一会因为被好好喂养而变得更好的生灵。
